
{{alias}}( x, t, y, p )
    Computes the squared hinge loss gradient with respect to a model parameter.

    If any argument is `NaN`, the function returns `NaN`.

    If `y` is not +1 or -1, the function returns `NaN`.

    When `t = 1.0`, we get the loss used by SVM.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: number
        Input value.

    t: number
        Margin threshold.

    y: number
        True target value.

    p: number
        Predicted value.

    Returns
    -------
    v: number
        Squared hinge loss gradient.

    Examples
    --------
    > var v = {{alias}}( 3.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.782 )
    ~-1.308
    > v = {{alias}}( 2.5, 1.0, 1.0, 0.202 )
    -3.99
    > v = {{alias}}( -1.3, 1.0, 1.0, -0.999 )
    ~5.197
    > v = {{alias}}( -2.0, 1.0, -1.0, 0.2 )
    -4.8
    > v = {{alias}}( NaN, 1.0, 1.0, 0.987 )
    NaN

    See Also
    --------
